claims: Lehigh University is a private research university.
Lehigh University is located in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania.
Lehigh University is located within the Lehigh Valley region.
Lehigh University's campus is situated on the north slope of South Mountain.
Lehigh University's campus is approximately 10 minutes from downtown Bethlehem.
Lehigh University has three contiguous campus areas totaling over 2,000 acres.
Lehigh University's Asa Packer Campus is the main, historic campus.
Lehigh University's Asa Packer Campus contains most academic buildings, libraries, and residence halls.
Lehigh University's Mountaintop Campus is located on South Mountain.
Lehigh University's Mountaintop Campus is home to the College of Education.
Lehigh University's Mountaintop Campus is home to Iacocca Hall.
Lehigh University's Murray H. Goodman Campus is situated south of the Asa Packer Campus.
Lehigh University's Murray H. Goodman Campus features athletic facilities, including the Goodman Stadium and Stabler Arena.
Lehigh Valley is Pennsylvania's third-largest metropolitan area.
